quality.review_scope: Independent complete main scientific audit passed for all four supplied pages, three figures and 22-reference bibliography. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete four-page supplied main only; no matching local SI located or verified. Cited full papers remain unreviewed.
Reagent purities, heating ramp, measured autoclave pressure, agitation, cooling rate, filter medium, wash volumes/repetition count and vacuum pressure are unreported.

The main method supplies 7 mmol copper chloride dihydrate and 4 mmol Te, a 100 mL vessel, 85% solvent filling, 160 °C for 10 h and vacuum drying at 60 °C for 4 h. The solvent volume is not separately printed as mL and is not silently converted.

Eight comparison contexts preserve solvent, ratio, precursor and temperature changes. Their absolute charges and complete temperature/dwell/workup assignments are not separately stated; they do not inherit the quantified main specimen or its figures and measurements.

XRD crystallite size and TEM diameter are separate approximate estimates. Lattice constants are indexed specimen parameters, not atomic coordinates; no exact unit-cell or particle-coordinate model is supplied.
Independent source audit passed; presentation remains pending.
Chemical identities and reused reference models do not establish solution speciation. Molecular presentation remains pending for identity-only cards; apparatus geometry is illustrative.
conflicts: The printed XPS charge reference is C 1s at 284.60 kV, while the reported specimen peaks and plotted axes use eV. This source unit anomaly is retained, not silently corrected or used in a calculation.
